newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mobil has 97 pct of Ampolex conv notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mobil has 97 pct of Ampolex conv notes.

text.p: Mobil Corp said on Wednesday it now owned 97 percent of Ampolex Ltd convertible notes following a settlement with Guinness Peat Group (GPG) Plc over GPG's claims about the notes conversion rate.

Mobil said it bought 5.60 million Ampolex convertible notes at a price of A$7.00 per note from GPG, which was the same price Mobil offered to note holders when it first made its takeover offer for Ampolex in February.
Mobil said it was currently developing a proposal to allow the remaining Ampolex convertible noteholders to receive A$7 per note and plans to detail this proposal by October 15.
Mobil already owns over 99 percent of Ampolex ordinary and preference shares following its its A$1.36 billion bid.
